column1: # Download manifest for 02_fetch_login.sh (login node only — compute nodes are offline).
# Tab-separated: dest_relative_path <TAB> url <TAB> sha256_or_SKIP
# CLAUDE.md/PLAN.md: "resolve exact accessions at build time — do not trust
# hard-coded URLs." Entries marked RESOLVE are deliberately not guessed; fill
# them from the live accession before running, and record the sha256 you got so
# the next tier can verify rather than re-trust.
# H1 (VCC 2025) — verified live 2026-08-24, Arc public bucket, no auth needed.
data/raw/vcc2025_h1/gene_names.csv
data/raw/vcc2025_h1/pert_counts_Training.csv
data/raw/vcc2025_h1/adata_Training.h5ad
# The other two H1 splits — 6.45 GB and 11.13 GB. Uncomment to take the full
# 300-perturbation H1 reference (Training alone is 150 perts / 13 panel genes).
#data/raw/vcc2025_h1/adata_Validation.h5ad
#data/raw/vcc2025_h1/adata_Test.h5ad
# Replogle 2022 — RESOLVED 2026-08-24. Figshare+ 20029387 is the original deposit
# (DOI 10.25452/figshare.plus.20029387.v1) but stores matrices DENSE: the K562
# genome-wide single-cell file is 61.31 GB there. scPerturb (Zenodo 13350497)
# mirrors the identical matrix — same 1,989,578 x 8,248 dense float32 — with gzip
# compression, at 8.20 GB. Same data, 7.5x smaller. Use the mirror.
# ⚠️ Only the GENOME-WIDE screen is useful. The two "essential" screens cover
# ZERO of the 300 challenge perturbations: the panel is built from non-essential
# genes, because a knockdown that kills the cell has no measurable response.
# Verified — essential∩panel = 0/2057 and 0/2390 (p ~ 2e-28 by chance).
# So K562_essential (9.93 GB) and rpe1 (8.10 GB) are deliberately NOT fetched.
data/raw/replogle2022/ReplogleWeissman2022_K562_gwps.h5ad
# Pseudobulk (per-perturbation profiles, ~500 MB total). These carry the full
# perturbation lists and the effect sizes used by the floor predictor, so most
# corpus questions can be answered without any single-cell download.
data/raw/replogle2022/K562_gwps_raw_bulk_01.h5ad
data/raw/replogle2022/rpe1_raw_bulk_01.h5ad
data/raw/replogle2022/K562_essential_raw_bulk_01.h5ad
# Annotation — needed on Aqua too, for Phase 2 harmonization by Ensembl ID.
data/annotation/gencode.v32.annotation.gtf.gz
data/annotation/hgnc_complete_set.txt
